# Implementation Plan: TDD-ready `zfa setup` baseline + `zfa tdd` plugin

**Branch**: `575-tdd-setup-tdd-plugin` | **Date**: 2026-08-29 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

## Summary

Make `zfa setup <name>` emit a TDD-ready day-zero baseline and add a `zfa tdd` plugin with subcommands `init`, `plan`, `gen`, `verify-red`, `make`, `refactor`, `run`, `verify`. Part 1 (the `zfa setup` baseline) lands first because it blocks everything else.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13. Pure-Dart root package; projects generated by `zfa setup` are Flutter projects.

**Primary Dependencies**: `args`, `yaml`, `path`, `code_builder`, `dart_style`, `analyzer`, `lib/src/plugins/test` (existing), `zfa make`/`zfa entity create`/`zfa build` (existing).

**Storage**: N/A. The plugin's persistent state is the `tdd/` directory inside the project the developer is working in.

**Testing**: `dart test` for the zuraffa codebase itself; `flutter test` for the projects generated by `zfa setup`. The new plugin's own behavior is verified with `dart test` under `test/plugins/tdd/`.

**Project Type**: CLI tool plus library code under `lib/`. This feature adds a new plugin under `lib/src/plugins/tdd/` and modifies the existing `zfa setup` command.

## Constitution Check

PASS on all six gates (Library-first, CLI interface, Test-first, Integration testing, Observability, Simplicity/YAGNI).
